## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (3)
- `GET /api/user/isLogin` — Check if the user is currently logged in.
- `GET /api/v1/users/publicagents/{publicagentToken}` — Retrieve public agent details using its token.
- `GET /api/v1/users/subscriptions/public-account-quota/{public-account-quotaToken}` — Get quota information for a public account.

    return false; // Assume not logged in on error
  }
}

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Klingai's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Klingai data without official API access
- Automate actions on klingai.com (faster than browser automation)
